features.title: Core FastAPI/React Skeleton with Health Check
acceptance: FastAPI backend runs on port 8000 with /health endpoint
React + TypeScript + Vite frontend runs on port 5173
Docker Compose with backend, frontend, and Keycloak services
Backend tests with pytest (at least 3 tests)
Frontend typecheck and build pass

features.title: Signal Processing Domain Engine
acceptance: REST API for creating, listing, and processing signals
Signal generation (sine, square, sawtooth, noise)
Signal operations (FFT, filtering, convolution)
Persistent SQLite storage with audit log

features.title: Three Core User Workflows
acceptance: Workflow 1: Generate and visualize a signal
Workflow 2: Apply filter and compare before/after
Workflow 3: Export signal data as CSV/JSON

features.title: OIDC Authentication with Keycloak
acceptance: Keycloak realm configuration
Backend session management with HttpOnly cookies
Frontend login/logout flow
Protected API endpoints

features.title: LLM Advisory Explanations
acceptance: Optional LLM explanations for signal operations
Support for OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama
Provider configuration via environment variables
Clear advisory labeling and error handling

features.title: Documentation and Packaging
acceptance: README with install/run/test steps and architecture diagram
